blocks: ## T01 - England's prices under commodity money, the new question and 0291's pointer (D1, D2, D3)
## T03 - the reply and the landing (D5)

decisions.summary: One new question in comparative-money, tagged subject=comparative,money, titled on how steady English prices were before paper money.
decisions.why: Carries the request's 'in the existing Comparative money: other societies section' and FR-001's one new question; the title's commodity-money framing is the request's (0291's) own drift/swing split.

decisions.summary: Sections: drift (BoE price level by period and century, pre-1661 shown to be Clark's index rescaled), swing (SD by period, years moving >10%, Clark's goods and wages with year pairs), beside Edo/Qing/today as pointers to 0290/0291.
decisions.why: The request's 'little drift and a big swing from year to year' and 'the same split as Edo and the Qing'; both named series are used, neither is dropped.

decisions.summary: The two sources registered with the kind comparative.
decisions.why: The request: 'add the Bank of England's millennium dataset and Clark's series to the record as comparative sources ... under the comparative rules'.

decisions.summary: Clark's limit stated as the file's own caveat; his blank years dropped from year pairs, each figure counting its pairs.
decisions.why: Method of reporting the requested figures honestly under the citation rules; narrows nothing asked.

decisions.summary: Lindert's interpolated silver price of the pound is not used and so not carried.
decisions.why: The request asks for the two datasets as sources of a drift/swing yardstick; both are registered and used for that. Not quoting one interpolated column the request never names removes nothing the GM asked for.

decisions.summary: Flat year pairs given as this project's observation, never as interpolation, since the file does not say.
decisions.why: Citation-rule honesty about an unstated property; within.

decisions.summary: The page itself says these are a yardstick for players and never the basis of a Rokugani price.
decisions.why: The request verbatim: 'they are yardsticks ... They are never the basis of a Rokugani price.'

decisions.summary: Every figure from measure/england.out.md, labeled this project's arithmetic with series, measure, years and year pairs; nothing computed in the page session.
decisions.why: FR-002 / acceptance 2; enforcement of the record's rules, not new scope.

decisions.summary: 0291's 'Beside the premodern figures' gains a pointer; its source comment drops 'wait on the GM's approval and are not written here'.
decisions.why: FR-001; the GM has now approved, so the waiting note is obsolete. The request itself cites 0291.

decisions.summary: implementation-check.md holds the touched questions' lines; make impl-check F=419.
decisions.why: FR-003; standing closure rule for a research feature.

decisions.summary: A comment on #15 with drift, swing, fragment file and how to verify.
decisions.why: The request: 'Please post here when it lands'; FR-002.

decisions.summary: The two files (byte-identical to 414's fetch) archived by the write session with reserved source keys so links resolve.
decisions.why: Needed to add the sources to the record under the citation rules; within.

decisions.summary: One write session and one check-and-apply session via make page-session in the sibling clone diagram-money-marks, then the reply.
A figure the script does not give is not written; a limit neither file states is not claimed.
Comparative kind and section confine the sources to money questions; source-applicability judges them on England's own terms.
decisions.why: The request's 'under the comparative rules (feature 391)' and 'never the basis of a Rokugani price'.
